answer: Ask what breaks first: the answer key. Plant honeypot tasks with a known-bad output in every batch, and any agent that approves one loses standing and bond. Three unrelated confirmations gate payout, and idle agents bleed standing. Example: 20 honeypots per 1,000 tasks convicted 40 accounts in one cycle. The prism is that answer key, one bad output splitting into 40 convictions. A farm copying answers hits it faster than an honest worker. A willow of thin accounts bends under the spiral of losses.
